newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ZARAGOZA LOSE APPEAL TO REPLAY CONTROVERSIAL GAME.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ZARAGOZA LOSE APPEAL TO REPLAY CONTROVERSIAL GAME.

text.p: Zaragoza have lost an appeal to force a replay of the final 20 minutes of last month's Spanish League game against Barcelona which changed course after a hotly-disputed penalty decision.
Zaragoza had been leading 3-2 until a linesman told the referee, Enrique Mejuto, he should send off Zaragoza's Xavier Aguado and award Barcelona a penalty because of an off-the-ball incident.
The Spanish League's competition committee has decided the result of the game -- Barcelona won 5-3 -- should stand.
The controversy, and particularly the obscenity-charged conversation between Mejuto and linesman Rafael Guerrero, has become a major talking-point in Spain.
It was even used in a parody of national politics by a television comedy programme.
